description: This Kotlin source file defines utility functions and constants for UI automator testing within the 'Now in Android' sample app, including functions for interacting with UI elements, waiting for UI elements, and dumping window hierarchy, as well as a package name constant that adapts based on build configuration.

methods.name: flingElementDownUp
methods.description: Performs a fling gesture downward and upward on a UI element, with margins to avoid triggering system navigation.

methods.name: waitAndFindObject
methods.description: Waits until a UI element specified by a selector appears on the screen within a timeout period and returns the UI object; throws an error if not found.

methods.name: dumpWindowHierarchy
methods.description: Dumps the current window hierarchy into a string representation for debugging.
